axial_tilt_deg.label: Axial tilt
axial_tilt_deg.help: Obliquity of the spin axis. Affects seasons, polar ice and the astronomy catalog.

rotation_period_days.label: Rotation period

tooltip.plate: The tectonic plate this cell belongs to
tooltip.convergenceRate: Normal component of relative plate velocity
tooltip.distanceToBoundary: Spherical distance to nearest plate boundary
tooltip.reliefStd: Standard deviation of elevation inside the cell — terrain amplitude below cell resolution
tooltip.peakElevation: Estimated highest point in the cell = mean elevation + 3.5 × relief σ (already amplified, shown raw)
tooltip.trenchAxis: Modelled elevation at the subduction trench axis
tooltip.convergentDuration: History contract: time since collision start on the cell's convergent segment
tooltip.convergentRun: History contract: integrated shortening distance along the segment since collision
tooltip.subgridIslands: Catalogued islands below cell resolution (count and highest peak)
tooltip.specialCrust: Special crust: hotspot chain (Wilson 1963) / ancient orogeny (Şengör 1990) / rift (Burke & Dewey 1973)
tooltip.koppen: Köppen–Geiger on land, with marine temperature bands where data are available
tooltip.ucc: Unified Climate Classification (UCC) profile v0: thermal band × reference supply–demand grade, thresholds shared globally
tooltip.soilType: USDA soil order (derived from parent rock + climate)
tooltip.fertility: Soil fertility level (direct agricultural potential input)
tooltip.descTempRange: Hottest minus coldest bin mean (full range, not half-amplitude; not a weather extreme)
tooltip.descBelowFreeze: Fraction of time with bin-mean temperature below the threshold — not actual frost days
tooltip.descAridity: AI = total precipitation / reference evapotranspiration (Hamon 1961, fixed 12 h daylength) — a reference supply–demand ratio, not soil moisture
tooltip.descDeficit: Σ max(Eref−P, 0) / Σ Eref — same-period shortfall fraction; ignores storage and lateral water transport
tooltip.descConcentration: C_TV = 0.5 Σ |q_i − w_i| — deviation of the precipitation time distribution from a uniform rate; undefined without precipitation
tooltip.uccClass: UCC main class = thermal background (polar/cold/temperate/tropical) × reference supply grade (arid/semi-arid/transitional/humid); ocean cells carry no supply axis
tooltip.uccMod: Modifiers on demand: strong seasonality = annual temperature range ≥ 25 °C; seasonal water stress = same-period deficit ≥ 50%

compute.title: Compute device
compute.unknownDevice: Browser did not report a device model
compute.deviceHelpTitle: Why is the integrated GPU selected?
compute.deviceHelp: WebGPU exposes only a high-performance preference hint; a web page cannot enumerate or choose a specific adapter. On hybrid-graphics Windows laptops Chrome often defaults to the integrated GPU, and no reliable browser flag overrides it. To use the discrete GPU, set the browser to High performance under Windows Settings → System → Display → Graphics, then fully quit and restart the browser. Outdated drivers can also be ignored, so keep the GPU driver current.
